questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true of the Supreme Court?

options.A: Every case appealed to the Supreme Court is ruled upon by the court.
options.B: The court helps set the public agenda by deciding which appeals to hear.
options.C: The court hears all cases when two or more justices agree that the case has merit.
options.D: In deciding cases, the chief justice's vote counts as two votes.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The court helps set the public agenda by deciding which appeals to hear.

questions.stem_text: What was the key difference between US expansion pre- and post- 1865?

options.A: US expansion was based on territory rather than markets post-1865
options.B: US expansion was based on markets rather than territory post-1865
options.C: US expansion was limited to Latin America post-1865

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - US expansion was based on markets rather than territory post-1865

questions.stem_text:
What, according to Systemic theories, is the primary determinant of a state's foreign
policy?

options.A: The character of a state's leader
options.B: The distribution of power in the international system
options.C: The distribution of power within a state's governmental system

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The distribution of power in the international system

questions.stem_text: What was meant by the term 'New World Order'?

options.A: A new democratic internationalism led by the United States
options.B: A new balance of power between the US and China

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A new democratic internationalism led by the United States
